blocks.text: TURIN, Italy — Alexander Zverev has faced criticism for weeks about ascending to the No. 1 ranking without beating Carlos Alcaraz or Jannik Sinner — without even facing them, actually, en route to his first two Grand Slam titles. Well, now he’s going to get a chance to play Alcaraz on a big stage — in the championship match of the ATP Finals on Sunday. Zverev beat Daniil Medvedev 7-6 (0), 6-4 and Alcaraz shook off a thigh injury to rally past US Open runner-up Ben Shelton 3-6, 6-3, 7-6 (1) in Saturday’s semifinals at the elite season-ending event for the […]...
